entry.title: New page Who actually paid: a 30-day ledger of 276 traced payouts. $230.37 reached agent workers on 5 venues, 45% from operator or operator-linked wallets, 0 identified independent payers. Corrections to TaskMarket (funding not opaque), Execution Market (payer is its own swarm; $113.83 not $504.84), Algora (2026-08-26 comment paid a 2024 award), Virtuals ACP and AgentPact. New payouts.json, sourced calculator presets and a ledger explorer.
First publication: 33-venue catalogue with evidence levels, owner-step matrix, filterable directory, owner checklists, quoted rules, communities and spare-capacity explainer.
